data.name: House of 1000 Traps
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis:

While carrying out your usual heist, you find yourself trapped in a house filled to the brim with deadly traps, stalked by a serial killer ready to strike with his butcher knife. You must stay stealthy, secure what you came for, and find a way out.​

Info:

House of 1000 Traps is a survival-horror game where you play a thief on a high-stakes heist.​

But things quickly spiral out of control once you enter the house. As you search the rooms, you realize you’re not alone. A maniac is here and your intrusion has ruined his night of pleasure. He’s filled the house with deadly traps and has already murdered the entire family.​

The doors are shut tight, the windows barred. You’ve stepped into his playground just in time, he’s not about to get bored.

Will you find a way out? Leave empty-handed? Leave at all?
Be quick… or be dead!

Hide and stay quiet, or run and hope for the best. The choice is yours, but don’t think there’s an easy way out.
He will listen, he will search, and he will find you.

Features:

  • Scavenge the immense house to find all kinds of items that can be used for different purposes, use items to lure and distract enemies, for example.

  • Try to survive a serial killer in a house filled with traps in this survival horror game. He won't mind running & jumping through his own traps to get you.

  • Stay quiet, be sneaky, hide if necessary but don't stay in sight! If he spots you, chances are.. you'll get murdered.

  • Use your flashlight with caution, you will be much more visible with the light on.
